card.name: Start of a new sentence's first word
card.fires_on: The first piece of a sentence-opening word right after a period, especially a long word split into parts, such as Adv(ise), Be(owulf), Un(ification), End(ocytosis). Also a few mid-word pieces like Adv(ances) and Import(ance).

modes.label: Adv after a risk sentence
modes.description: The start of the word Advise opening the next sentence after animal reproduction findings in a label.
modes.example: based on body surface area (BSA).<< Adv>>ise pregnant women and females of reproductive potential

modes.label: Capitalised start of a long word
modes.description: The first piece of a long capitalised word that opens a sentence in scientific text.
modes.example: and options for experimental tests. <<Un>>ification of gravity with the electrowe

modes.label: Inside a word like Advances
modes.description: A piece of a longer word beginning with Adv or Import, within or at the start of a sentence.

card.plain: It fires on the first fragment of a long word that starts a new sentence, such as the A in Advise or the Be in Beowulf.
